false_reopened_events.decision: New confirmed_active event for unknown to active. It stays in the database but is left out of the Changes feed, because it is routine rather than a change.

newest_first.note: Vacancies sort by first_seen. Rows imported in the same bulk run tie and fall back to ID order.
